"Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned AGA for the State.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants for quashing the entire proceedings of the Criminal Case No. 0002 of 2015 (State of U.P.
Versus Gaurav Chaturvedi and others), arising out of the Case Crime No. 3259 of 2014, under Sections 363, 366, 376, 392, 323 I.P.C. and 3/4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012, Kotwali Orai, District Jalaun pending before the learned Additional District and Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Jaluan at Orai, on the basis of the compromise.

entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Jaluan at Orai

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the parties have entered into a compromise.
A copy of the compromise has been filed along with this application.
Learned A.G.A. submits that the compromise effected between the parties may be verified before the court concerned.

In the interest of justice, the applicants and the opposite party nos. 2 and 3 are directed to appear before the court concerned on 28.2.2023 and shall submit the compromise, which shall be verified by the court concerned and a report in this regard shall be submitted before this Court within 15 days thereafter.
List on 21.03.2023 as fresh.
Till the next date of listing, further proceedings in the aforesaid case shall remain stayed.

"
4. Pursuant to the order of this Court dated 20.2.2022, learned Additional District and Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Jaluan at Orai has verified the compromise between the parties on 3.3.2023 and information to this effect has been received before this Court on same day i.e.
3.3.2023.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Jaluan at Orai
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 5 . Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that applicant no. 2 and opposite party no. 3 have solemnized the marriage and living together happily and out of their wedlock, they have been blessed with children.
Therefore, present proceeding may be quashed.

6. Sri Akshay Raj Singh, advocate holding brief of Ms. Richita Singh, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has not objected the aforesaid fact and submitted that in case proceedings is quashed, he would have no objection.
